name: Expressive AI Robot Head
shortDescription: 12-servo robot head that runs a local speech pipeline (Silero, Whisper, llama.cpp, Zonos) and drives expressions over ROS 2.
description:
A ROS 2 robotic head that connects a local LLM, speech, vision and servo control, taking AI past text into physical, more humanlike interaction.

Highlights:
- Real-time speech loop: Silero VAD → Whisper (STT) → llama.cpp running GPT-OSS-20B → Zonos (TTS).
- GPU-accelerated with CUDA and PyTorch, with VRAM usage tuned so the whole pipeline runs locally on Ubuntu/WSL2.
- A 12-servo head combining organic mesh modeling in Blender with parametric solids in Fusion 360.
- FreeRTOS firmware on an ESP32 for synchronized servo actuation.
- A ROS 2 mapping layer that ties LLM reasoning, audio analysis and OpenCV tracking to the servos.

Repos: [`MaidReal/Head`](https://github.com/MaidReal/Head) (hardware + firmware) · [`MaidReal/brain`](https://github.com/MaidReal/brain) (LLM + speech pipeline).

Submitted to the OpenAI Open Model Hackathon (September 2025) as "MaidReal Head".
